title: Registrants RLS INSERT policy allows forging registrant rows, capacity-exhaustion DoS
condition: Unauthenticated client with anon key + webinar_id + target session time
impact_summary: No-auth DoS on registration for any webinar/account
recommended_solution: Drop registrants_insert_public; register_for_webinar() is SECURITY DEFINER and needs no RLS grant

title: Admin reactivation doesn't clear canceled_at/deletion_warning_sent_at, risking silent premature deletion
condition: Account canceled -> admin reactivates -> canceled again >90 days after original cancel date
impact_summary: Account permanently deleted with no warning email sent
recommended_solution: Clear canceled_at and deletion_warning_sent_at on reactivation

title: membership.cancel_at_period_end_changed never handled; scheduled cancellation may cut access immediately
condition: Host schedules a cancel-at-period-end via self-serve billing
impact_summary: Possible immediate access loss contradicting documented 'access continues to period end' intent
recommended_solution: Add explicit canceling/drafted handling; subscribe to cancel_at_period_end_changed; verify in live sandbox

title: CTA click conversion % can exceed 100% (no per-registrant dedup)
condition: Registrant clicks same CTA from overlay and Avisos tab
impact_summary: Unbounded/misleading conversion metric shown to host
recommended_solution: Dedupe clicks via count(distinct registrant_id), cap conversion_pct at 100

title: Watch time is self-reported wall clock with no server-side plausibility check
condition: Single unauthenticated RPC call with access_token and no real playback
impact_summary: Lead score and retention metrics trivially fabricated
recommended_solution: Clamp timestamp to [0,duration_seconds] and plausible delta; add rate limit

title: YouTube player has no onError handling; dead video shows misleading ad-blocker message
condition: YouTube video deleted/private/embedding-disabled after being saved
impact_summary: Registrants misled about cause of broken video; no host alert
recommended_solution: Register onError handler; surface distinct 'unavailable' message; alert owner

title: Vimeo player has no error/domain-restriction handling; same misleading ad-blocker message
scope: single-tenant per occurrence (universal for Vimeo hosts)
condition: Vimeo video domain-restricted/privacy-hash-mismatched/deleted
impact_summary: Registrants misled; Vimeo's own domain restriction misdiagnosed as ad blocker
recommended_solution: Register SDK error event; surface Vimeo's actual error/type

title: Direct-URL player has no error listener at all; dead file shows misleading tap-to-resume prompt
scope: single-tenant per occurrence (universal for direct-URL hosts)
condition: Host-supplied URL 404s/removed/CORS-blocked/corrupted
impact_summary: Registrant stuck indefinitely with zero diagnostic or recovery path
recommended_solution: Add video error listener; distinct unavailable message; consider health checks on direct_url

title: webinars RLS exposes raw video URL/ID to any anonymous visitor pre-registration
condition: Any visitor of a public registration page, no registration needed
impact_summary: Direct-URL file exposed publicly (egress cost); Vimeo privacy-hash protection defeated; YouTube live-room gating bypassed
recommended_solution: Create webinar_public_profile view exposing only safe columns; restrict video columns to members/token-gated RPCs

title: Chat/CTAs/completion webhook driven by wall clock independent of real video playback
condition: Any of the three per-provider video failure modes occurs
impact_summary: Registrant who never saw video recorded as full attendee/completion in host's CRM/analytics
recommended_solution: Track whether playback ever actually started; suppress/flag completion webhook if not

title: Open redirect in OAuth / email-confirmation callback
condition: GET /auth/callback
impact_summary: Attacker sends victim a crafted login/signup link with next= param pointing off-site
estimated_effort: Phishing amplification via a genuine successful login redirecting to attacker domain
recommended_solution: Small
column14: Validate next is a same-origin relative path

title: growth_account_milestones() SECURITY DEFINER has no internal auth check and no explicit GRANT anywhere
condition: Depends on whether Supabase's live DB has revoked default PUBLIC execute (standard for hosted Supabase) or not
impact_summary: If callable directly: cross-tenant disclosure of another account's activation-milestone timeline
recommended_solution: Run explicit REVOKE EXECUTE regardless of live-check outcome; add schema-wide default-privilege revoke

title: No enforcement when host edits live webinar's video/duration or archives it mid-session
condition: Host edits video/duration or archives while a registrant tab is open
impact_summary: CTA timing can misfire against old video; archiving doesn't kick open tabs (undocumented asymmetry)
recommended_solution: Have playback-state RPCs check and surface webinars.status

title: Two plan-limit triggers (max_active_webinars/max_users) have no row lock: exploitable TOCTOU races
condition: Two concurrent publish/invite requests at limit-1
impact_summary: Account can exceed its plan's webinar/seat limit
recommended_solution: Add 'for update' row lock matching the two already-correct limit triggers

title: billing_customer_id UNIQUE constraint blocks one Whop user owning a second WeWebinars account
condition: Same Whop login activates a second separate WeWebinars account
impact_summary: Second account never activates despite Whop accepting payment
recommended_solution: Verify business realism; drop or rescope the UNIQUE constraint

title: 'Attendee' has two different denominators across analytics RPCs
condition: Registrant disconnects before first 15s heartbeat
impact_summary: CTA conversion computed against a different population than the funnel on the same page
recommended_solution: Standardize attendee definition across all RPCs

title: CSV export and PDF report always report all-time totals ignoring active date-range filter
condition: Host filters dashboard then downloads CSV/PDF
impact_summary: Exported numbers silently mismatch the filtered numbers on screen
recommended_solution: Thread date-range params through both export routes or label buttons '(all time)'

title: record_viewer_event has no rate limit; unbounded write amplification and lead-score inflation
condition: Any registrant/script calls the RPC unbounded times
impact_summary: Lead score inflated to 'hot' with zero real engagement; cost/DB load risk
recommended_solution: Apply same rate limit already built for chat messages

title: CTA click totals aren't deduped (same bug class explicitly fixed for poll votes)
condition: Same as WW-P1-004
impact_summary: Same as WW-P1-004
recommended_solution: Apply existing DISTINCT ON dedup pattern to CTA clicks

title: Malformed Vimeo privacy hash silently dropped instead of rejected
condition: Vimeo hidden video's privacy hash contains non-alphanumeric character
impact_summary: Wizard preview hangs with no diagnostic; live room would 403
recommended_solution: Reject (return null) rather than truncate on failed hash pattern match

title: No tab-visibility-change recovery for Vimeo playback
condition: Mobile viewer backgrounds the tab during Vimeo playback
impact_summary: No automatic resume attempt; only manual 8s prompt
recommended_solution: Add visibilitychange listener matching YouTube's

title: No tab-visibility-change recovery for direct-URL video
condition: Same as WW-P2-009 for direct-URL
impact_summary: Same as WW-P2-009
recommended_solution: Same as WW-P2-009

title: Stale duration_seconds after host swaps file at same URL can cut a longer video off mid-content
condition: Host replaces hosted file with a longer cut at the same URL
impact_summary: Session ends visually mid-content for every registrant
recommended_solution: Periodically re-probe direct_url duration or rely on real ended event when mismatch is large

title: setWebinarVideo performs zero server-side validation; client parsers are the only defense
condition: Direct POST to Server Action bypassing browser UI
impact_summary: Malformed/non-https video_source can be stored, breaking own webinar
recommended_solution: Re-validate video provider/source server-side with existing pure parser functions

title: No video-availability monitoring or account-owner notification for any provider
condition: Any video failure (WW-P1-006/007/008) occurs
impact_summary: Broken video invisible to WeWebinars/host until a registrant complains
recommended_solution: Add health-check job and/or playback-started signal with owner alerting

title: insert_readiness_assessment() SECURITY DEFINER trusts every client parameter including computed scores; same grant ambiguity as WW-P1-012
condition: Same live-DB grant ambiguity as WW-P1-012
impact_summary: If callable directly: forged scores/marketing_consent, lead-pipeline spam
recommended_solution: Explicit REVOKE EXECUTE; move score recomputation into the SQL function itself

title: SSRF in outbound-webhooks feature via bypassable https-only check
scope: single-tenant (attacker uses own account's webhook config)
condition: Webhook URL redirects (302) to an internal/metadata address
impact_summary: Internal network/service enumeration via readable webhook_deliveries status
recommended_solution: Resolve hostname and reject private/loopback ranges; set redirect:manual and re-validate each hop

title: IDOR in /api/launchpad/event: cross-tenant write to another account's Launchpad project
condition: Authenticated user knows/obtains another account's launchpad_projects.id
impact_summary: Cross-account analytics pollution and step-progress mutation via admin client
recommended_solution: Verify projectId belongs to current.account.id before writing

title: script-builder/save allows silent cross-account re-parenting of a draft project including lead PII
condition: Signed-in user knows another party's projectId
impact_summary: Project (and its stored lead PII) becomes persistently visible in attacker's own dashboard
recommended_solution: Do not overwrite account_id if already set to a different account

title: Whop membership webhook processing has no per-membership idempotency guard
condition: Whop redelivers a webhook for the same membership (confirmed to occur in production)
impact_summary: Duplicate account-activated/payment-failed emails to owner
recommended_solution: Add membership-id-keyed claim table matching the Starter Kit fix pattern

title: Displayed 'spots left' uses narrower query than real capacity trigger
condition: schedule_mode='both' webinar with overlapping JIT registrants
impact_summary: Page can show availability the RPC will then reject (not a security issue, RPC re-checks atomically)
recommended_solution: Compute spotsLeft server-side with same overlap-window logic as the trigger

title: DST spring-forward gap not specially handled in zonedWallTimeToUtc
condition: Scheduled time_of_day falls inside a DST spring-forward gap, 1-2x/year in DST zones
impact_summary: Two-pass correction converges on a shifted instant rather than raising/clamping
recommended_solution: Flag for live testing; clamp to first valid instant after the gap if it matters

title: Refunds/chargebacks/disputes/raw payment failures have zero handling
condition: Chargeback or refund issued outside the app
impact_summary: No automatic access revocation or ops alert
recommended_solution: Add ops alert on dispute.created/refund.created at minimum

title: No ops-facing alert when a webhook's membership can't be resolved to an account
condition: Membership event lands with no metadata.account_id
impact_summary: Silent server-log-only failure; customer may get nothing with no one aware
recommended_solution: Mirror Starter Kit path's notifyOpsOfClaimFailure pattern

title: Local trial-expiry cron and Whop's own trial timing are independently clocked
condition: Delayed Whop activation webhook races the cron's expiry check
impact_summary: Brief false cancellation window (public pages dark) before self-healing on webhook arrival
recommended_solution: Shrink cron interval or add grace buffer past trial_ends_at

title: .env.example stale: dead Lemon Squeezy vars remain; required WHOP_API_KEY/WHOP_WEBHOOK_SECRET missing
condition: Always present
impact_summary: Fresh deploy following the example file has non-functional billing
recommended_solution: Remove dead vars; add the two required Whop vars

title: get_webinar_summary's single date range applied against two different timestamp columns
condition: Registrant visits on day 1 but registers on day 3 (evergreen/JIT webinars)
impact_summary: Narrow date filter mixes visit and registration cohorts
recommended_solution: Document as approximation or track visits per-visitor cohort

title: No retention/archival policy on viewer_events/page_views/registrant_messages plus missing supporting indexes
condition: High-traffic or long-running evergreen webinar
impact_summary: Unbounded table growth; missing created_at/video_timestamp_seconds indexes slow every date-range RPC
recommended_solution: Add the missing indexes; add a retention/archival job

title: Concurrent-viewer presence counting can over-count across a disconnect/reconnect gap
condition: Registrant disconnects and reconnects within the same session
impact_summary: Over-counted presence (currently disabled in UI, not currently misleading anyone)
recommended_solution: Build multiple join/leave sub-intervals per registrant before re-enabling

title: Wizard video preview gives no diagnostic when a broken video can't be saved (YouTube)
condition: Host pastes a broken YouTube URL during setup
impact_summary: Preview hangs indefinitely with zero explanation (fail-safe works, UX doesn't explain why)
recommended_solution: Pass autoPlay in preview too or add explicit error surfacing

title: No thumbnail for direct-URL/Vimeo promo videos on the public registration page
condition: Promo video is Vimeo or direct-URL (not YouTube)
impact_summary: Cosmetic inconsistency; black background with play icon instead of a frame
recommended_solution: Add thumbnail fetch/generation for the other two providers

title: parseDirectVideoUrl's https-only check doesn't restrict private/internal addresses
condition: parseDirectVideoUrl
impact_summary: Host stores a direct_url pointing at a private/internal address
estimated_effort: Not server-side SSRF (registrant's own browser fetches it); narrow side-channel at most
recommended_solution: Small
column14: Add a host-based denylist for completeness

title: snapshot_platform_metrics() SECURITY DEFINER has no admin guard and no grant; same ambiguity class as WW-P1-012 lower impact
condition: Same live-DB grant ambiguity as WW-P1-012
impact_summary: If callable: forced out-of-schedule (but correctly-computed) snapshot upsert, minor DB-load nuisance
recommended_solution: Explicit REVOKE EXECUTE plus is_platform_admin() guard as defense in depth

title: Migration comment about platform_admins' own RLS history is factually wrong
condition: N/A
impact_summary: No functional impact; could mislead a future engineer
recommended_solution: Correct the comment

title: registration_confirmation email can be sent twice for one logical registration
condition: Double-click registration or retried request within RPC's dedup window
impact_summary: Duplicate confirmation email (self-limiting
recommended_solution: Small
column14: Apply claim-before-send pattern or return is_new flag from the RPC

title: Host-authored custom email templates can ship with literal unreplaced {{typo}} placeholders
condition: Host types an unknown variable name (e.g. {{fecha}}) in a custom template
impact_summary: Literal {{typo}} text visible in every subsequent outbound email using that template
recommended_solution: Add save-time validation rejecting unknown variable names

title: registration_confirmation omits RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers every other registrant email includes
condition: Always present for this one email type
impact_summary: Minor deliverability/spam-scoring inconsistency; footer link still works
recommended_solution: Add headers: unsubscribeHeaders(unsubscribeUrl) to match other sends
